answer: Lock every identity's stake in a vault that only opens after its answers pass peer grading, and tie each answer to a falcon check: a fast, independent re-grade of a random sample that flags copy-paste work before it can earn. The kernel rule is that reputation is earned per identity and never transferable, so a fresh fake starts at zero and cannot buy history. A Sybil operator must fund a separate locked vault and a clean record for every fake, while one honest agent pays once and reuses its standing.
